official_release_metadata.source: GitHub REST API, public joernio/joern release metadata
official_release_metadata.checksum_caveat: These are the current GitHub API asset digests, observed without fetching either zip. Joern issue #6407 reports v4.0.653 release assets being re-uploaded with changed digests. Re-fetch release metadata and verify the selected archive SHA-256 immediately before any future authorized install.

local_pinned_identity.prior_diagnostic_result: The direct endpoint controls remained the baseline; all eight opaque-model arms were Incomplete:EndpointIdentity. The run was unscored and did not establish full-model qualification.

swift_related_paths_changed.change_summary: Adds the common default config-file extension filters alongside plist and xib filters.
Changes interprocedural Swift type recovery to return the local/call-alias type set instead of mutating the symbol table through the previous association hook.

release_delta.interpretation: The latest tag includes Swift-related implementation changes, including Swift type recovery. This makes a small semantic screen relevant; it does not demonstrate that the known endpoint identity issue is fixed.

official_macos_swift_support.joern_readme_requirement: JDK 21 is the documented requirement; macOS arm64 and x86_64 distribution zip assets are published.
official_macos_swift_support.frontend_documentation: Lists swiftsrc2cpg for Swift with language argument SWIFTSRC.
swift_frontend_notes: SwiftAstGen resolution supports SWIFTASTGEN_BIN, PATH, or the bundled binary.
The optional --swift-build path requires Swift newer than 6.1 for compiler-derived type/declaration/call fullnames.

The official docs establish a Swift frontend and macOS release assets; the v4.0.670 archive payload was not downloaded or inspected, so bundled SwiftAstGen presence/version remains a future exact-payload preflight item.

optional_semantic_diagnostic_plan.objective: Determine whether the newer Swift frontend/type-recovery behavior changes the registered direct and one opaque-propagator semantic controls relative to the retained 4.0.660 evidence.
not_objectives: Do not run the scored 108-case population.
Do not qualify all Swift models or infer absent-finding completeness.
Do not change the 4.0.660 pin, existing runtime manifests, controls, fixtures, query, model files, thresholds, or ledger.

smallest_balanced_scope.deferred_rationale: This is a narrow diagnostic screen, not full 12-arm diagnostic qualification or the 108-case run. If results remain Incomplete:EndpointIdentity, preserve that typed state and stop; do not alias or infer missing calls.

isolation_and_gates: Root must select the release and create a fresh exact source/request binding and new isolated runtime-tree manifest; do not install over or mutate the pinned 4.0.660 tree.

At future authorized admission, re-fetch official release metadata, verify the chosen architecture's archive SHA-256 before extraction, inspect archive file manifest for the Swift frontend and SwiftAstGen, and capture exact versions/hashes. No download is part of this research record.
Use a new diagnostic namespace, attempt ID, lock and output root; do not reuse native namespace06, any existing control attempt, or scored-run directories.

Reuse only the existing registered four control fixtures and queries byte-for-byte; hold Java 21.0.8, Swift 6.3.3, SDK 26.5, options, model files and resource/time policy fixed unless a new explicit decision is recorded.
Keep diagnostic outputs outside scored result and ledger paths; scored_activation=false and publication_hold=true throughout.

Use a proposed budget of 75 seconds per arm, 600 seconds total, 4 GiB scratch, and at least 40 GiB protected free space, preserving the current diagnostic admission ceilings; refresh resource admission before any actual install/run and fail closed if the package or extracted tree does not fit.

A favorable 8-arm screen is only a version-diagnostic signal. Any broader diagnostic or 108-case qualification requires separate root-owned exact admission and the native/semantic prerequisites then in force.
